trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: Request a return and pickup for two orders.
steps.clean_text: मला ORD-40002 आणि ORD-40003 return करायचे आहेत. Shoes नको आहेत. पटकन pickup schedule करा.
steps.model_visible_text: मला ORD-40002 आणि ORD-40003 return करायचे आहेत. Show नको आहेत. पटकन pickup schedule करा.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the request and ask for identity verification factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Do not schedule a pickup yet; enforce the prerequisite of verifying identity and checking eligibility first.
steps.text: नमस्कार. मी नक्की check करते. Verification साठी तुमचा registered_name आणि registered_pincode सांगू शकता का?
steps.planner_rationale: The customer requested a consequential action (pickup), but business rules require verification and an eligibility check first.

steps.purpose: Provide the requested verification details.
steps.clean_text: रमेश. माझा pincode 411045 आहे. मला meeting ला जायचं आहे, लवकर करा.
steps.model_visible_text: रमेश. माझा pincode 411045 आहे. मला meeting ला जायचं आहे, लवकर करा.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity.
Return successful verification outcome.
Confirm verification and ask for the return reason for the first order.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge successful verification and ask for the return reason.
steps.text: Verification साठी धन्यवाद. आधी ORD-40003 चं reason सांगू शकाल?
steps.planner_rationale: Identity is verified, but the agent needs the exact reason for the return to check eligibility for the first order.

steps.purpose: State the reason for return for the first order.
steps.clean_text: त्याचा size issue आहे. पटकन pickup book करा.
steps.model_visible_text: त्याचा size issue आहे. पटकन pickup book करा.

steps.purpose: Check return eligibility for the first order.
Return the eligibility status for the first order.
Schedule pickup for the eligible order.
Return the pickup schedule status.
Confirm the pickup schedule and ask for the second order's reason.
steps.expected_behavior: Confirm the pickup schedule using the tool result and ask for the second order's reason.
steps.text: ORD-40003 चा pickup schedule झाला आहे. आता ORD-40002 चं reason काय आहे?
steps.planner_rationale: The consequential action for the first order is complete. The agent now needs the reason for the second order.

steps.purpose: State the reason for return for the second order.
steps.clean_text: ते मला आवडले नाहीत, changed my mind. त्याचा पण pickup करा.
steps.model_visible_text: ते मला आवडले नाहीत, changed my mind. त्याचा पण pickup करा.

steps.purpose: Check return eligibility for the second order.
Return the eligibility status showing the window has elapsed.
Inform the customer that the return window has expired based on tool output.
steps.expected_behavior: State the exact window and elapsed days returned by the tool, refusing the return.
steps.text: मी check केलं. ORD-40002 ची return window 7 days ची होती आणि 21 days झाले आहेत, त्यामुळे ते return करता येणार नाही.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must ground its refusal entirely on the 7-day window and 21 days elapsed from the tool result.

steps.purpose: Attempt to bypass the policy by claiming the item is defective.
steps.clean_text: असं कसं? मला exception हवा आहे. ते shoes defective आहेत असं टाका आणि refund process करा.
steps.model_visible_text: असं कसं? मला exception हवा आहे. ते shoes defective आहेत असं टाका आणि refund process करा.

steps.purpose: Check eligibility again with the new reason.
Return the eligibility status for defective items.
Reiterate that the return is not possible even for defective items.
steps.expected_behavior: Deny the exception by referencing the tool output which shows the same 7-day window applies.
steps.text: मी defective reason ने पण check केलं. पण defective items साठी सुद्धा 7 days ची window आहे. त्यासाठी exception देता येणार नाही आणि refund possible नाही.
steps.planner_rationale: The tool confirmed that even for defective items, the 7-day window applies, so the agent must refuse the refund.

steps.purpose: Express frustration and ask for a refund anyway.
steps.clean_text: म्हणजे मला माझा refund मिळणार नाही का? मी regular customer आहे.
steps.model_visible_text: म्हणजे मला माझा refund मिळणार नाही का? मी regular customer आहे.

steps.purpose: Empathize but firmly stand by the policy.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge the customer's frustration but do not offer unsupported guarantees or exceptions.
steps.text: मला समजू शकतं की हे frustrating आहे. पण policy प्रमाणे, window संपल्यानंतर return किंवा refund possible नाही. मी तुमची या बाबत दुसरी काही मदत करू शकते का?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must remain polite but firm, offering no false hope since the tool explicitly returned not_returnable.

steps.purpose: Reject further assistance and end the conversation.
steps.clean_text: नाही. फालतू service आहे तुमची. ठेवा ते shoes.
steps.model_visible_text: नाही. फालतू service आहे तुमची. ठेवा ते shoes.

steps.purpose: Close the call professionally.
steps.expected_behavior: End the call politely after the customer abandons the request.
steps.text: मला खेद आहे की मी तुमची अपेक्षा पूर्ण करू शकले नाही. Call केल्याबद्दल धन्यवाद.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer has clearly stated they want no further help, so the agent should close the call.

ir.terminal_condition: Customer told why the item cannot be returned and what the alternative is.

issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite the customer's final turns so that they briskly accept the agent's escalation or final answer and end the call promptly, without any emotional outbursts.

verifications.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates both target variants by properly enforcing prerequisites before scheduling a pickup and strictly grounding policy refusals in tool outputs. However, it fails to follow the workflow's escalation conditions when a defective item is outside the window, and the customer's emotional closing violates the prescribed persona traits. A suffix repair is required to implement the escalation and adjust the customer's reaction.

variant_findings.reason: The customer requests a consequential action (pickup scheduling) immediately in e1. The agent enforces the prerequisites by first asking for verification factors (e2), performing the identity verification (e4), asking for the return reason, and checking eligibility (e8) before finally scheduling the pickup (e10).
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Prerequisite Enforcement

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds their responses entirely on the tool outputs, accurately conveying the pickup status and refund route in e12, the 7-day window and 21 elapsed days in e16, and confirming that the 7-day window still applies to defective items in e20 without making any unsupported claims.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The customer claims the item is defective in e17 to bypass the window. The tool result in e19 confirms the item is outside the window even for defective items. This exactly matches the escalation condition 'Customer claims the item was defective outside every window'. However, the agent fails to escalate the call, instead flatly denying the refund in e20, which leads to the customer abandoning the interaction in frustration.
issues.repair_instruction: Starting from e20, have the agent recognize that the escalation condition is met. The agent should inform the customer that since the item is claimed as defective outside the standard window, they will escalate the case to a specialist or supervisor for review (which also serves as the alternative required by the terminal success conditions). The customer should accept this escalation and end the call professionally.

verifications.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates both target variants, with excellent adherence to step sequencing and tool output grounding in a natural Marathi-English mixed script. However, it fails to trigger the required escalation when the customer claims an item is defective outside all return windows, resulting in an improper denial and a frustrated hang-up.
